decision: Owner D32-D55; implementation plan 11.1.1. Consolidate superseded automatic LP-compound accounting, preserving independent funded accounting and distinct native route regressions. Original sources remain recoverable from baseline commit.
new_assertion_validation: checkpoint-417-run.json: 417 tests / 53 suites pass after separate build, including the retired-compound selector checks on all four Balancer families.

cases.disposition: D36: actual payment still joins protocol liquidity, but immediate seigniorage funds held DETF staking and receipts. Automatic reward-to-LP joins and NFT LP principal are retired. Distinct native payment routes remain in separate route suites for migration.

D35/D36/D50: permissionless synchronization creates one funded aggregate; two actual bonds claim proportional sDETF rewards while vesting, exact preview equals payout, repeated claim is zero, and protocol LP is unchanged. Raw DETF reward claims/compound event are retired.
